summary: Shows using `changed_when: True` on a copy task so it always reports changed and its handler restarts the service every time.
questions: How do I make a handler run every time a task runs, even if nothing changed?
Can changed_when control whether a handler is notified?

answer_card.title: Use changed_when to control notifications
answer_card.answer_md:
Handlers are notified only when a task reports changed, so `changed_when` controls notification. To restart every time the config is copied:

```yaml
- name: Copy httpd configuration
  ansible.builtin.copy:
    src: ./new_httpd.conf
    dest: /etc/httpd/conf/httpd.conf
  changed_when: True
  notify: Restart apache
```
